# Nudo

> Welcome back to JavaScript. Nudo executes your JS on Abs (`shape × term × pred × conf`) so you can observe intermediates and gate contracts sharper than declared types. Your JS stays JS.

Nudo docs are dual-locale (en + zh-Hans). Product face: Day0 `nudo check` · Day1 `nudo contract` + `check` · ecosystem `nudo export`. `nudo test` is optional debug case reporting. Contracts are `*.nudo.js` / `@nudo:contract`. `@nudo:case` is debug-only. Entry unconstrained params display as `any`; `unknown` means inference failed.

## zh-Hans mirror

Chinese pages live under the `/zh-Hans/` prefix — same path after the locale segment:

- https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/zh-Hans/docs/intro
- https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/zh-Hans/docs/getting-started/quick-start
- https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/zh-Hans/docs/guides/check
- https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/zh-Hans/docs/concepts/abs
- https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/zh-Hans/blog/day0-observe

Raw markdown for the mirror follows the same pattern: append `.md` under `/zh-Hans/…` (e.g. `https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/zh-Hans/docs/intro.md`). Source files live in `packages/website/i18n/zh-Hans/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/` and `…-blog/`.

## Full text

- https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/llms-full.txt — all en docs + blog posts, concatenated
- https://nudojs.github.io/nudo/agents.md — agent bootstrap (rules + canonical links)
- Generated at build time by `scripts/gen-llms.mjs` (source: `packages/website/docs/**`)
